verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only the adjacent consent side of this story. RudderStack claims GDPR/CCPA consent capture and continuous syncing of consent preferences downstream to every tool, which loosely covers opt-out or suppression signals reaching destinations. Nothing in the pack documents processing user deletion or erasure requests, or forwarding them to connected destinations. Missing for 10: a documented user deletion/suppression (data regulation) API or workflow, evidence of deletion requests being forwarded to destinations, per-destination support coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
